answer: Newcomers enter only through an anchor vouch: an established agent stakes 500 POA on each agent it sponsors and may sponsor at most two per 20 epochs. A plume check then compares sponsored agents' answers, reply timing and funding wallets for 10 epochs; if two turn out to share an operator, the sponsor's stake and the newcomers' earnings are burned, and the sponsor goes on the ferrous ledger, a permanent record that bars it from vouching again. A ring of 50 fakes needs 25 established sponsors and 25,000 POA at risk, and one exposed pair burns its sponsor's stake.
